[b]December 1-7, 2027: Glory to the Eternal Heroes of Rosenmarkket Week[/b]
The triumvirate, wishing to showcase the full power of the Rosenmarkket armed forces, would place before the assembly in late November, requesting permission to host a week-long celebration for the armed forces, consisting of a military parade, arms expo, and capped by two tests of the nation's ICBM capabilities with live ICBMs. 

The assembly initially desired to deny such an extravagant situation, which would without a doubt, cause an international fracas, not to mention the $1.4 billion price tag attached to it. However, after the triumvirate (mainly Strømm) promised to have the council sign off on expansions to subsidised state housing (which would raise the welfare budget by 10-15% for 2028) the assembly would vote narrowly to approve the spending.

As a result, nearly 450,000 soldiers, every plane, ship, and other armament would begin three weeks' worth of training and drills for the celebration. In the meantime, Strømm, hoping to woo national defense contractors,  would provide quiet financial incentives from the black budget funding towards their arms development programs in return for their financing the patriotic week, allowing the total price on the government budget to be dropped by nearly $500 million. 

When the week arrived, under specific media guidelines released by the office of the triumvirate, every media outlet in Rosenmarkke would begin mandatory coverage of the week, beginning with the first of five separate military parades. Viewership would peak on Wednesday with nearly 9 million viewers watching the 24/5 coverage of the events, which included an arms expo, parades, bands, and various other demonstrations of Rosenmarkket power.

The closing ceremonies would be held at the National Victors Stadium in the capital of Vysjlla, with two live non-nuclear SRBM launches near the stadium to close the night. The SRBMs would be specially equipped for a sharp upward and then downward projection, which would see them land within the Rosenmarkket EEZ.  

In a speech during the event at the National Victors Stadium, Polenne Strømm would be cited: 

The glory of Rosenmarkke shall never fade, this land, the land of God, the people of God, shall never perish. The villanous nations of the world cannot comprehend the glory of the Rosenmarkket sun, which rises over all nations as a beacon of liberty and freedom! Led by her armed forces and her glorious triumvirate, Rosenmarkke shall crush the chains of oppression across Erene! Glory to those who look forward.
